acceptanceCriteria: llm_invoke() in src/controllers/llm.py checks params.metadata for sandbox attribute after resolving assistant config
When sandbox == 'daytona': calls create_daytona_backend(api_key) to get (daytona_sandbox, daytona_backend)
When Daytona backend is available: passes it as the default to CompositeBackend (store routes preserved)
When Daytona backend creation fails: falls back to StateBackend, appends a SystemMessage to params.input.messages notifying user (e.g. 'Daytona sandbox unavailable, falling back to default sandbox.')
daytona_sandbox.stop() called in the finally block after agent execution completes (only if daytona_sandbox is not None)
Requests without metadata.sandbox behave identically to current behavior (no regression)

userStories.notes: Read src/controllers/llm.py fully. The existing init_backend() is at line ~43 and the finally block is at line ~148. The CompositeBackend pattern: CompositeBackend(default=daytona_backend, routes=built_routes) replaces the StateBackend default while keeping store routes unchanged.
